records.rationale: `EmbedController#best` only requires the presence of `embed_url` (`params.require(:embed_url)`) and does not validate its host. The request-time access control is `ensure_embeddable`, which checks `URI(request.referer).host == SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, i.e., relies on the `Referer` header. The actual host validation of the *embed_url* happens later in `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` (called from the async `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` after `Jobs.enqueue`), so an invalid `embed_url` can be accepted/enqueued/rendered before that check. records.issue_text: Update path crashes when the embed's post was deleted: post = embed.post yields nil and PostRevisor.new(nil).revise! raises NoMethodError, propagating up through TopicRetriever/PollFeed and killing the whole poll loop for that feed
records.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the update path does `post = embed.post` and then unconditionally calls `PostRevisor.new(post)` when the content SHA changes. If the referenced post has been deleted (the migration enforces `post_id` NOT NULL but does not enforce a FK, and there is no `dependent: :destroy` cleanup shown), `embed.post` will be `nil`, causing a `NoMethodError` inside `PostRevisor` initialization/usage. records.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the `Topic.transaction do ... end` block only creates the `TopicEmbed` record if `creator.create` returns a `post` (`if post.present? ... TopicEmbed.create! ... end`). If `PostCreator#create` fails and returns `nil` (or otherwise yields a blank `post`), the transaction completes with no exception, no logging, and `import` returns `post` (i.e., `nil`) at the end.
